mcqs.question: Under the Andhra Pradesh Sports Policy 2024–29, what horizontal reservation was notified for meritorious sportspersons in direct recruitment to government departments, local bodies, public sector undertakings and specified services?
mcqs.explanation: The notified reservation is 3% horizontal reservation for meritorious sportspersons in direct recruitment under the Andhra Pradesh Sports Policy 2024–29. The tempting options 5%, 65% and 2% do not represent the reservation percentage; the figures relate to other details of the policy.
